# Patientory

> Patientory is a digital health passport wallet — a mobile app (iOS & Android) that stores your complete medical records encrypted on the PTOYMatrix blockchain, analyzes them with an AI health coach, and pays you crypto rewards ($PTOY) for healthy choices and consented data sharing. Around the wallet sits the Care Health Data Marketplace: six services that reduce the cost of care, from clinical-trial matching to discounted medications.

Patientory Inc. is HIPAA and GDPR compliant. The company serves individual consumers as well as employers, payors, brokers, pharmacy benefit managers, health centers, clinical research organizations, and sports organizations.

## Main

- [Home](https://patientory.com/index.md): What Patientory is — the health wallet, AI health coach, Health Score, rewards, and the Care Health Data Marketplace
- [Download the app](https://patientory.com/download.md): Get Patientory for iOS or Android
- [About](https://patientory.com/about.md): Company, mission, vision, values, and products
- [Contact](https://patientory.com/contact.md): Address, phone, email, and booking links

## Care Services

- [CareTrials](https://patientory.com/caretrials.md): Clinical trial matching based on your health profile, with rewards for participation — includes active and completed trials
- [CareGLP](https://patientory.careglp.com/partner/patientory): GLP-1 weight-loss medication programs with 1:1 video coaching
- [CareMeds](https://patientory.com/caremeds.md): Discounted medications powered by Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company
- [CarePharmacy](https://patientory.com/carepharmacy.md): Free prescription savings card — up to 80% off at 60,000+ US pharmacies
- [CareLabs](https://patientory.com/carelabs.md): Diagnostic testing with at-home kits and results within 24 hours

## Health Programs

- [Patient-Authorized Longitudinal Health Data](https://patientory.com/services/longitudinal-health-data.md): Identity, consent, and longitudinal health data infrastructure — FHIR-normalized records accessed only with patient authorization; for payors, providers, researchers, and digital health builders
- [Pre-Diabetes Prevention Program](https://patientory.com/services/pre-diabetes.md): Prevent Type 2 diabetes with a free health kit (Fitbit, smart scale, CGM, HbA1c test) and coaching
- [Diabetes Management Program](https://patientory.com/services/diabetes.md): Comprehensive diabetes management with CGM, at-home labs, GLP-1 support and nutrition coaching
- [Hypertension Management Program](https://patientory.com/services/hypertension.md): Blood pressure management with at-home cuff, labs, GLP-1 guidance and coaching
- [Heart Health Program](https://patientory.com/services/heart-health.md): Cardiovascular health with remote monitoring, cholesterol/lipid testing and coaching
- [Cancer Screening Program](https://patientory.com/services/cancer.md): Proactive early detection with at-home labs and a colon cancer FIT test
- [Chronic Kidney Disease Program](https://patientory.com/services/chronic-kidney-disease.md): Kidney Protect — monitoring, at-home testing and coaching to slow CKD progression
- [Prevention & Sexual Health Program](https://patientory.com/services/prevention-sexual-health.md): Private at-home testing and coaching for sexual health and prevention
- [Weight Management Program](https://patientory.com/services/weight-management.md): Sustainable weight loss with wearables, labs, GLP-1 guidance and nutrition coaching

## Who We Serve

- [Individuals](https://patientory.com/enterprises/individuals.md): Consumers who want to own their health data and earn rewards
- [Health & Benefits Brokers](https://patientory.com/enterprises/health-benefits-brokers.md): Benefits brokers offering data-driven wellness programs to clients
- [Self-Insured Employers](https://patientory.com/enterprises/self-insured-employers.md): Employers reducing healthcare costs with preventative programs
- [Payors](https://patientory.com/enterprises/payors.md): Health plans reducing spending and improving member outcomes
- [Pharmacy Benefit Managers](https://patientory.com/enterprises/pharmacy-benefit-managers.md): PBMs optimizing prescription management with blockchain data
- [Pharmaceuticals / Clinical Research Organizations](https://patientory.com/enterprises/clinical-research-organization.md): Trial sponsors accelerating recruitment and decentralized trials
- [Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHC) / Rural Hospitals](https://patientory.com/enterprises/federally-qualified-health-centers.md): Community health centers serving Medicaid populations
- [Sports Organizations](https://patientory.com/enterprises/sports-organizations.md): Teams optimizing athlete performance, recovery, and injury prevention
